about_the_game:
🎭 Assassins Arena – Hide in Plain Sight

Assassins Arena is a competitive online stealth game for 2–8 players where everyone looks like an NPC—but only some of them are real. Your goal? Blend into the crowd, find your target, and eliminate them without getting caught.

You’re not faster or stronger, you’re just smarter. Every action matters.

🕹️ Core Gameplay

  • Look Like an NPC
    Your character behaves exactly like AI civilians—walking, stopping, doing tasks. You must mimic this behavior to avoid suspicion from other players.

  • Hunt & Assassinate
    Depending on the mode, you’re assigned a target (or all players are). Press one button to assassinate—but if you get it wrong, your position is revealed for seconds.

  • Avoid Mistakes
    Kill the wrong NPC, and everyone will see who you really are. You only get one chance to stay invisible.

  • Objective System
    Certain locations on the map allow you to interact for clues. But standing still makes you vulnerable.

🎮 Game Modes

  • Target Mode – All players chase the same NPC. First to strike wins—or dies trying.

  • Elimination Mode – Each player has a secret target. Kill your mark, survive the others.

  • Team Mode – Two teams: one protects a disguised NPC, the other must find and assassinate them.

  • Single Player – Play against AI targets. One wrong kill ends the match.

🌍 Maps & Visuals

Each match takes place in a stylized map packed with animated NPCs. Maps range from city streets and pirate docks to western towns. NPCs follow randomized behaviors, so blending in requires timing, movement, and acting skills.

  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 660 / AMD Radeon HD 7870

short_description: Assassins Arena is a stealth-based multiplayer party game where you blend in with NPCs, subdue your targets, and deceive your opponents! Outsmart others in fast-paced, action-packed matches, either single player or online with 2-8 players.
